# Issue Tracker

This repository tracks issues on GitHub Issues. All engineering skills (to-issues, triage, to-prd, diagnose, tdd, improve-codebase-architecture, zoom-out) will read and write issues using the GitHub API and CLI tools.

- Issues are created, updated, and closed via GitHub Issues.
- No local markdown or external tracker is used.
- For private repos, ensure you have appropriate permissions and authentication for automation.
